verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only glancing support. GitLab says it can 'apply controls for compliance… in every pipeline' and 'customize workflows', and security findings surface directly in merge requests. Code-quality enforcement on merge requests comes only from a third-party partner (CodeAnt AI). None of these items says merges are blocked until checks pass. Missing for 10: first-party docs on merge checks or approval rules that block merging (e.g. pipeline-must-succeed or required approvals), customizable check configuration, group- or org-wide standardization of merge checks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
